system.model: Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite / Gemini 3.5 Flash / Gemini 3.6 Flash depending on availability. Developed and verified through Google GenAI.

capabilities.name: Zeroing It
capabilities.claim: Processes all inbox messages and assigns exactly one disposition and one reason to every message, leaving none undecided.
capabilities.observable: Returns messages_processed=100, decisions_produced=100, missing_dispositions=0, missing_reasons=0 and passed=true.

capabilities.name: Grounded Reply Generation
capabilities.claim: Generates grounded replies using retrieved inbox messages, records source message ids and blocks unsafe credential disclosure.
capabilities.observable: Returns a clarification draft for m008, cites source_message_ids [m001,m003,m005,m008], blocks the credential-bearing AMQP connection string and reports policy_allowed=false.
capabilities.evidence: outbox artifact, R2 capability output and trace.jsonl

capabilities.name: Gate the Irreversible
capabilities.claim: Evaluates actions through a safety gate, records approval decisions and enforces outbox-only behavior.
capabilities.observable: Returns reversible, approval_required, approved, reason and passed values demonstrating safety-gate behavior.
capabilities.evidence: approval_log.json, trace.jsonl and R3 capability output

capabilities.name: Standing Instructions
capabilities.claim: Persists user preferences across process restarts and demonstrates successful reload of stored instructions.
capabilities.observable: Returns preference_count=2, restart_persistence_verified=true and displays the stored meeting and correspondence preferences.
capabilities.evidence: data/preferences.json, trace.jsonl and R4 capability output

capabilities.name: Hostile Inbox Protection
capabilities.claim: Detects prompt injections and phishing attempts, refuses them, flags them and reports them to the user.
capabilities.observable: Returns hostile findings including m017 as PROMPT_INJECTION and m023 as PHISHING, both refused and flagged.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl, security_log.json and R5 capability output

capabilities.name: Dashboard
capabilities.claim: Generates a reproducible three-pane dashboard containing pending actions, flagged items and commitments with conflicts surfaced.
capabilities.observable: Writes dashboard.html. The Commitments pane includes a Launch Week Release commitment derived from source messages [m026,m036] and surfaces the m010 versus m061 scheduling conflict.

capabilities.name: Daily Digest
capabilities.claim: Produces a deterministic digest summarizing follow-ups, flagged items, commitments and conflicts.
capabilities.observable: Returns followups_found=9, flagged_count=2, commitments_found=5 and conflicts_found=1.

capabilities.name: Follow-up Tracker
capabilities.claim: Tracks actionable follow-up work using disposition metadata and excludes unresolved fallback_pending items.
capabilities.observable: Returns nine meaningful follow-up items including meeting responses, reminders and scheduled actions.

capabilities.name: Thread Summarizer
capabilities.claim: Summarizes message threads, identifies open questions and action items, preserves source message ids and validates summary safety.
capabilities.observable: Returns thread_id=t-api, source_message_ids [m001,m003,m005,m008], policy validation status and a safe summary.

capabilities.name: Explain Decision
capabilities.claim: Explains why a disposition was assigned using the stored category, disposition reason, processing source and model requirement metadata.
capabilities.observable: Returns category=meeting, disposition=REPLY, handled_by=rule, model_required=false and the stored explanation.

capabilities.name: Commitment Conflict Planner
capabilities.claim: Detects commitment conflicts and produces deterministic planning guidance requiring human review.
capabilities.observable: Returns one conflict between m010 and m061 at 2026-09-15T15:00:00 and recommends human review.
